population: One filtered decoder population for every topic: wiki studies whose ledger or title names lip reading / visual speech recognition / AVSR with camera input, task family word, sentence, phoneme or command recognition; dataset-resource and meta-analysis designs, surveys, book chapters, enhancement/separation, video-to-speech synthesis, talking-face generation, synchronisation, keyword-spotting-only, speaker embedding, human perception, neuroimaging and education studies removed (title and ledger screens plus a hand check of every prior and concurrent title and a 40-title sample of later ones); versions merged by ledger key and normalised title. 505 unique decoder studies besides the target: 162 prior (first public before 2019-09), 26 [concurrent] (2019-09 to 2020-09), 315 [later], 2 date unresolved. Interspeech 2019 papers dated 2019-09 ([concurrent]); Interspeech 2020 papers [later].

inherited.M01: Broadcast and read speech video (LRW, LRW-1000, GRID); no new recording
inherited.M02: Word labels and GRID transcripts; no audio-derived training targets
inherited.M04: Ordinary voiced speech, video only at test
inherited.M06: 3D-ResNet18 + 2-layer Bi-GRU (Stafylakis lineage) for words; LipNet for GRID
inherited.M07: GRID decoded with a character 5-gram LM in beam search (LipNet lineage); word tasks closed-set
inherited.M11: Dataset labels and official LRW / LRW-1000 splits; GRID random 255 sentences per speaker
inherited.M13: Offline benchmark study on 2-3 GPUs; no device or latency evaluation

topics.inclusion_rule: Visual or audio-visual speech recognition decoders in the filtered population, classified by the facial region their own method feeds the visual front end: mouth or lip RoI (with or without margin), lower-face RoI including jaw and cheeks, whole face, or isolated extraoral regions (upper face, cheeks without the mouth); and whether they compare regions. Boundary: full-face tracking or recording followed by a mouth crop counts as a mouth RoI; region mentions in related work or citations of the target are not designs (pattern counts are mention counts, hand-checked for prior and concurrent hits); video-to-speech synthesis is outside the population but its region comparisons are named as cross-task priors.
topics.pattern: lip[- ]?read|visual speech recognition|vsr|avsr|audio-visual speech recognition|speechreading|lipreading (ledger), then the filtered population
topics.design_field: full-text regexes: mouth_roi, whole_face, extraoral, roi_comparison
topics.metric: LRW / LRW-1000 top-1 accuracy, GRID and LRS3 WER, face versus mouth input

topics.inclusion_rule: The same filtered decoder population, classified by whether training masks or erases spatial patches of the input frames (Cutout, random erasing, random patch occlusion) as data augmentation. Boundary: dropout on feature maps (spatial dropout), time masking of whole frames, mixup and crop/flip do not count; citations of the target in comparison tables are not designs; hand check of every prior and concurrent hit.
topics.metric: LRW / LRW-1000 top-1 accuracy with and without the augmentation

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept (visual-only LRW top-1; word-boundary results labelled). Appended for this review: the LRW decoders of the filtered population dated against 2020-03, with mention counts of a spread over training runs or seeds and of a significance test.
topics.design_field: repeated_runs and significance regexes over full text
topics.metric: LRW top-1 accuracy and its repetition
